title: Kiosk Management System
description: A comprehensive kiosk and retail management system developed to facilitate multi-store management, product creation and categorization, and user access control for individual stores. The system seamlessly connects kiosks to specific stores and manages the Point of Sale (POS) terminals linked to each kiosk, ensuring that all transactions are recorded accurately and in real-time. The platform is structured around three primary roles: Global System Admin, Store Admin, and Kiosk (with connected POS), each possessing tailored access rights and dedicated functionalities. The frontend is specifically designed to handle POS integrations and user interactions, delivering a fast and highly interactive user experience. Implemented with a modern architecture and a unified structure, this project ensures that sales, product management, and multi-store transactions are perfectly synchronized and fully controllable. Additionally, the platform provides full multilingual support for Persian, Arabic, and English.
features: Multilingual Support: Full localization for three major languages (Persian, Arabic, and English).
Multi-Store Management: Unified and centralized administration across multiple retail locations.
Real-Time Transactions: Instantaneous and synchronized recording of all financial transactions.
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Secure access management divided into three distinct operational tiers.
Interactive UI: A fast, responsive, and highly interactive user interface designed for seamless operation.
Smart POS Integration: Intelligent and seamless connection between physical kiosks and Point of Sale (POS) terminals.

title: Nini Dooz
description: An integrated production management and e-commerce full-stack web application built with Laravel and React (Inertia.js) for a children's clothing manufacturer. The platform is divided into two primary modules: an online storefront and a production line management system. The e-commerce section includes a comprehensive product catalog, shopping cart, streamlined checkout process, and an admin panel for order management and seller verification. The production module features a dedicated portal for factory workers to log their daily performance across multiple sewing lines, utilizing a multi-line reporting system. Managers can create, allocate, and approve work sessions while monitoring the real-time progress of each production stage. The user interface is designed using Tailwind CSS and Radix UI, featuring full Persian (RTL) language support and Jalali calendar integration. The project is deployed on the Liara platform and incorporates OTP authentication, robust role management, and an integrated online payment gateway.
features: Comprehensive Admin Dashboard: Advanced capabilities for allocating workers to specific sewing lines and approving detailed production reports.
E-Commerce Platform: Fully functional online store equipped with a shopping cart, secure payment processing, and order tracking.
Multi-Line Production Reporting: Dedicated system for workers to accurately record actual daily production metrics per sewing line.
Advanced Authentication & RBAC: OTP-based login and multi-level Role-Based Access Control encompassing Admins, Production Managers, Workers, and Sellers.
Localization: Full integration of the Jalali (Solar) calendar with a native RTL Persian user interface.
Seller Verification System: Automated workflows for verifying seller identities, including document review and check processing.

title: Appointment Management
description: A comprehensive, full-stack medical clinic management web application built with Laravel and React (Inertia.js), designed to optimize and streamline every aspect of clinic operations, from scheduling and reception to personnel and financials.
features: Interactive Appointment Calendar: Features full Drag & Drop functionality for the intuitive rescheduling and seamless management of all clinic appointments.
Comprehensive Reception Panel: Empowers reception staff with full patient profile management, including registration, complete profile views, and detailed visitation histories.
Strategic Clinic Room Management: Provides strategic control over all clinic rooms and ensures their optimal allocation to both doctors and patients for maximised efficiency.
Flexible Personnel Shift Scheduling: A robust system for defining staff workdays and managing complex weekly shift plans with ease and flexibility.
Analytical Admin Financial Dashboard: Offers a detailed dashboard with multiple analytical charts for clear and accurate reporting of income, payments, and financial performance.
Integrated Patient Communication Logs: Built-in functionality for registering and tracking calls and all communication logs with patients for better relationship management.

title: Cryptocurrency Exchange Application
description:
A comprehensive cryptocurrency exchange web application built on Next.js 16 and React 19, featuring a fully bilingual Persian/English user interface.
The trading system facilitates the buying and selling of digital assets, complete with real-time price tracking through interactive charts and full transaction histories.
It features a multi-currency wallet that supports deposits (top-ups), withdrawals, and cross-network transfers across various blockchains.
The platform integrates bank account management, Rial (fiat) transactions, and investment features, alongside a dedicated profile panel and OTP authentication.
Designed as a Progressive Web App (PWA), it delivers a near-native mobile application experience directly within the browser.
Data fetching and state management are handled by SWR, and Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) two-factor authentication is implemented to ensure maximum account security.
features: Crypto Trading & Charting: Buying and selling of cryptocurrencies with real-time price charts and candlestick history.
Multi-Currency Wallet: Comprehensive support for deposits, withdrawals, and transfers across different blockchain networks.
Market Price Tracking: Live market prices equipped with daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly timeframe filters.
Bilingual Interface: Seamless Persian/English user interface with automatic RTL/LTR direction switching.
Advanced Security: OTP and TOTP authentication for secure logins and the verification of sensitive transactions.
Fiat Operations: Full support for Rial transactions and the management of registered bank accounts.
PWA Ready: Installable Progressive Web App offering a user experience highly comparable to a native mobile app.
